first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The dark gray-black long gun held by Person A, with a slender front section, a wider rear section, and prominent light-colored mottling on its surface.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The gray-black, uneven ground surface outside the opening, scattered with rubble and elongated fragments.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: The damaged wall nearby with patterns and rectangular openings, as well as the unevenly sized ruined brick-and-stone walls outside and the distant building remains.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: The cluster of dark, leafless trunks, broken stumps, and trees with remaining branches in the exterior scene.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The extensive gray-white smoke-cloud background above the exterior scene, with some areas tinged yellow-green or warm white.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: The orange-yellow glow and open flames scattered near the exterior rubble and ruined walls.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The first-person figure who appears only as partial hands wearing dark gloves and holding Weapon A.

entities.name: airborne debris
entities.identification: A collection of small dark airborne fragments and, in the later portion, prominent slender, bent, strip-like fragments.

At frame 0, the muddy shell-cratered ground is gray-black and uneven, with a large amount of gray rubble mixed into it.

At frame 0, the muddy shell-cratered ground is gray-black and uneven, with a large amount of gray rubble mixed into it; parts of the surface are shiny, slender branches and elongated fragments are scattered across it, and angular rubble is visible beyond the central opening.

At frame 0, the cluster of dead trees contains multiple dark gray-black leafless trunks and broken stumps, together forming slender or broken silhouettes.

At frame 0, the smoke-cloud-filled sky is a gray-white and yellow-green misty background, with the opening on the left appearing more gray-white and the right side more yellow-green; transitions between light and dark are soft, the gray mist is denser lower down, and the silhouettes of distant tree trunks fade accordingly.
At frame 0, the orange point of fire appears as a small area of orange-yellow firelight visible in the gray-green environment.
